name: What is the process for an aging-in-place renovation with Simply Construction?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for an aging-in-place renovation with Simply Construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins with an initial consultation to discuss your specific needs, goals, and budget. We then conduct an on-site assessment to evaluate your current home and identify suitable modifications. Following this, we develop a detailed design plan and provide a transparent estimate. Once approved, we handle all necessary permits and commence construction, managing the project from start to finish with regular communication until completion and final walkthrough.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process involves consultation, on-site assessment, design planning, detailed estimates, permit handling, and full project management through completion.
